E-11346-LISTING-MED20
Verified Official BIS

BIS MED 20 committee material (2026)

BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 11346:2002 (Tests for agricultural and water supply pumps — Code of acceptance) as the hydraulic performance testing standard under Committee MED 20.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/bisconnect/pow_new/Pow/download_pow_pdf_dept_commtt/68/300/
E-1239-SCOPE
Secondary Summary

BIS IS 1239 Standard — web search summary 2026

IS 1239 (Part 1) covers mild steel tubes (welded and seamless, plain end, screwed end or screwed and socketed) for conveyance of water, gas, air and steam, in Class A (Light), Class B (Medium) and Class C (Heavy). Tubes may be supplied as uncoated or hot-dip galvanized (GI). Nominal bore 6 mm to 150 mm. Tender explicitly cites 'IS 1239 / 90' for 50mm GI pipes Class B for column pipe installation.

https://www.bis.gov.in/
E-14220-SCOPE
Verified Official BIS

BIS Summary of IS 14220:2018

BIS describes IS 14220:2018 as Openwell Submersible Pumpsets and discusses agriculture and irrigation applications.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/tmp/tbl5_2024-11-11_1182.pdf
E-14536-LISTING-2026
Verified Official BIS

BIS MED 20 committee material (2026)

BIS committee material lists IS 14536:2018 as Selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset - Code of practice (First Revision).

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/bisconnect/pow_new/Pow/download_pow_pdf_dept_commtt/68/300/
E-1554-SCOPE
Secondary Summary

BIS IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 Standard — web search summary 2026

IS 1554 (Part 1):1988 covers PVC insulated heavy-duty electric cables (armoured and unarmoured) for working voltages up to 1100 V, used for electric supply and control including underground installation. Tender cites 'IS 1554/ 1988' for armoured LT UG cable (3.5x10 and 3.5x25 sq mm) for main connection.

https://www.bis.gov.in/
E-694-SCOPE
Secondary Summary

BIS IS 694:2010 Standard — web search summary 2026

IS 694:2010 specifies PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables and cords (circular and flat) with rigid and flexible conductors for rated voltages up to and including 1100 V. Tender cites 'IS 694-1990' for flat 3-core sheathed PVC insulated submersible pump cable of sizes 2.5, 4 and 6 sq mm. IS 694 has been revised; current edition is IS 694:2010.

https://www.bis.gov.in/
E-8034-LIFECYCLE
Verified Official BIS

Implementation guideline for revised IS 8034:2018

IS 8034:2002 was revised as IS 8034:2018 and the old standard would stand withdrawn after 04-04-2019.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/tmp/CMD3_IS8034_guidelines_17112018.pdf

Verified Official BIS

IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 9283 (line-operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets) as a normative reference for the motor component of submersible pumpsets.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/tmp/CMD3_IS8034_guidelines_17112018.pdf
E-8034-SCOPE
Verified Official BIS

BIS Government Procurement pump standards booklet

BIS describes IS 8034:2018 as Submersible Pumpsets used for clear, cold water in agriculture and water supply, commonly in boreholes/borewells/tubewells.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/gpportal2/assets/img/Full-BookletGP.pdf
E-9283-LISTING-2026
Verified Official BIS

BIS MED 20 committee material (2026)

BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 9283 (Line operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets — Specification) as a standard under the submersible pumpset committee. Current revision noted as IS 9283:2024 on BIS portal.

https://www.services.bis.gov.in/php/BIS_2.0/bisconnect/pow_new/Pow/download_pow_pdf_dept_commtt/68/300/
